propositions: When two bundle objects exist for the same ref in S3, git ls-remote returns ambiguous ref, clone fails with 'multiple updates for ref not allowed', and push stalls because git-remote-s3 rejects writes while bundles>1 before attempting any write.

Upstream Doctor.fix_multiple_bundles is interactive (blocking input() on EOF) and discards the non-chosen head's unique events, causing data loss in an append-only event log where each divergent head may carry distinct ticket events.

The heal must acquire the helper's per-ref S3 lock, re-enumerate bundles under the lock (TOCTOU guard), fetch all divergent heads, losslessly merge them via iterated 2-parent merges (never octopus/union driver), write the merged bundle, then delete originals, ensuring ≥1 bundle with full history survives every crash point.

All S3 operations (lock, enumerate, put, delete) route through git-remote-s3's own S3Remote/.s3 client; boto3 is transitive under the optional [s3] extra so core rebar acquires no direct S3 dependency.
Merge conflicts in non-derived files cause the heal to abort without deleting any remote bundles, release the lock, and surface fsck-recover hint rather than discard a parent.

push_tickets_branch auto-invokes heal_multi_bundle exactly once (guarded by healed_once) on the multi-bundle signature before retrying push; the local merge fold runs under rebar's write_lock and cannot race concurrent local committers.
